name: thin-entrypoint-matrix-evidence-topology-optimization
title: Reduce thin-entrypoint matrix evidence time from the four-full-run baseline to one full run plus focused proofs
description: Create a reusable matrix proof bundle that measures the existing four-full-matrix verification topology as Red and replaces it for future consumers with one complete 26-row execution plus focused scheduler, receipt-integrity, and wiring proofs. The Green target is five minutes or less without changing evidence timeouts, weakening fail-closed semantics, rewriting B-3cec history, or using cross-process cached receipts. Development depends on B-3cec reaching DONE.
